title: Typo in README install section
body: In the README under Installation it says 'pip instal -r requirements.txt'. Should be 'pip install'.

title: Pagination shows duplicate item on page boundary
body: On GET /recipes?page=2&per_page=10 the first item of page 2 is the same as the last item of page 1. Looks like an off-by-one in the OFFSET calculation in recipes/query.py. Expected: no overlap between pages. Repro: seed 25 recipes, request pages 1 and 2, compare ids.

title: Let users export the shopping list as a printable page and as plain text
body: After picking a recipe, users see the shopping list on screen. Add an Export button with two options: a print-friendly page (grouped by supermarket aisle) and a plain text copy to clipboard. Needs a new aisle field on ingredients with a migration, UI for the export menu, and tests for grouping. Items already in stock must be excluded.

title: App feels slow
body: It feels slow sometimes. Can we make it faster?

title: Replace session cookies with JWT auth
body: We should move from session cookies to JWT so we can support a mobile client later. Update login, logout and the auth middleware. Existing users must stay logged in. Rotate the signing secret in all environments.
